services.name: Tween & Teen Tumbling
services.desc: A 60-minute tumbling class in which tumblers will cartwheel, aerial and round-off back handspring their way through the gym using safe, fun, and proven lesson plans. A class for new tumblers and those who have mastered basic tumbling skills. Class will begin with an interactive cardio warm-up and stretch to prepare for fun, technique-building skill circuits. Weekly lesson plans will rotate through various pieces of tumbling equipment. Coach Becky, a certified Gymnastics Instructor, and Hands-On Trainer, has over a decade of coaching experience after competing for 12 years in high school and private club gymnastics.
